name: Mugiten!
source:
Summer vacation. Main character sees a girl on a roadside and can't forget her. He approaches her and asks to stay in her house even though he has no reason. This way a new season of his life begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-september-2008-sumaga.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
暑假。主角在路边看到一个女孩，无法忘记她。他接近她并要求留在她家，尽管他没有任何理由。就这样，他人生的新季节开始了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-september-2008-sumaga.html]vndbreview[/url]]
